description: AutoRAG pipeline: discover documents and load test data, prepare and validate vector or Graph RAG search spaces, extract text, pre-select models, optimize RAG templates, and build a leaderboard. Neo4j Graph RAG patterns include knowledge-graph extraction.

components.description: Download benchmark test data from S3, sample records for evaluation, and discover input documents.

stages.description: Validate S3 access, download benchmark JSON, sample records, and write test data artifact.
List and sample source documents in S3 and write documents_descriptor.json.

components.description: Prepare and validate the AutoRAG search space, including Neo4j Graph RAG configurations alongside vector stores.

stages.description: Resolve and validate the requested models, build vector or Neo4j Graph RAG search spaces, and write the report.

components.description: Download listed documents and extract text with docling.

stages.description: Load descriptor, download sources, run docling extraction, and write text artifacts.

components.description: Trim the model set via pre-selection when the search space exceeds the model limits.

stages.description: When the report exceeds the model caps, evaluate models over a benchmark sample and write a limited report; otherwise pass the full report through unchanged.

components.description: Run ai4rag optimization and emit agentic_rag or agentic_graph_rag pattern artifacts.

stages.description: Validate settings, run ai4rag optimization, perform graph extraction and KG build for Graph patterns, and write pattern directories, metrics, and notebooks.
Aggregate pattern metrics and render leaderboard HTML.
